description: Chunking methods compared on every built dataset but LiteraryQA, which has no evidence spans, the other stages at the README's baseline: no augmentation, bge-m3, dense retrieval, no reranking. Markdown and HTML methods run only on datasets with that rendering. The semantic methods are in semantic_chunking_eval.json and LumberChunker in lumberchunker_eval.json. Run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe experiments.py experiments/chunking_eval.json

chunk_embedding.description: A safeguard: every method here caps chunks at 1,024 tokens, far below bge-m3's limit of 8,192, counted with its own tokenizer.
